Docs.summary: Marks a native method to use faster Java Native Interface (JNI) transitions.

remarks.para: While a fast native method executes, garbage collection cannot suspend its thread and may be blocked. Do not use this annotation on long-running methods or methods that perform significant I/O or acquire native locks that can be held for a long time. This annotation has no effect on non-native methods.
